version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: The skill is coherent for Google Ads work, but it asks users to install and allowlist an unpinned third-party ClawLink plugin that can mediate high-impact Google Ads actions.

dimensions.detail: Using OAuth through ClawLink and Google Ads API tools is proportionate to the purpose, but users are relying on a third-party hosted credential and proxy flow for ad account access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install flow runs `openclaw plugins install clawhub:clawlink-plugin`, allowlists `clawlink-plugin`, and restarts the gateway without an immutable version, digest, bundled source, or locally verifiable integrity metadata.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions repeatedly require preview and explicit user confirmation before campaign, ad group, audience, or destructive changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The plugin installation, `tools.alsoAllow` configuration, and gateway restart create cross-chat tool availability for the whole ClawLink plugin rather than a locally reviewed, Google-Ads-only artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to inspect Google Ads accounts, run GAQL reports, and create or update campaigns, ad groups, and audiences; those capabilities match the artifact, but they include business-impacting write operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if the Google Ads account has production spend or customer-list access. Install only if you trust ClawLink and the ClawHub package source, verify the plugin through the linked provider materials, connect only the Google Ads accounts needed, and require a clear preview plus explicit confirmation before any write action.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The cited third-party plugin installation is disclosed and purpose-aligned for enabling ClawLink, but the artifact-backed concern remains because the enabled plugin is mutable/unpinned and its source or integrity data is not included for review.
